data.dates: Previously confirmed events retain exact days. New 1974 DRI founding retains year precision (late-year qualifier in its title); SMC agreement and initial sales retain month precision. Equal start/end partial dates identify one milestone within that period, not a whole-period process. Never infer a confirmed day from plotting geometry.
data.plans: Targets, offers and future rights are distinguished from completed actions.
data.naming: Stable actor/product identifiers; aliases retain spelling variants.
data.event_structure: Events use date, participants, actions, outcomes, agreement_terms, metrics, product_refs and related_event_refs. Processes use period and phase_refs instead of event_type/date; phase_refs identify narrative context, not asserted start/end dates.
data.provenance: This JSON structures the narrative; product specifications remain in the technical catalog. The technical catalog is an author-facing, all-years reference, not a contemporaneous press kit. All 1979 public and partner-facing next-generation references must follow the disclosure policy in ncc_1979_campaign.json; internal identifiers do not establish public product names.
data.phase_order: Nine consecutive phases from 1972-01-01 through 1983-12-31; later manufacturing roadmap is provisional and does not establish later product sales.
